translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizheng the Kuizhang Pavilion was changed to the Hall of Propagating Culture and the Directorate of Literary Arts to the Directorate of Honoring Culture; Boqi was Lecturer of the Hall of Propagating Culture, teaching the sons of imperial affines and great ministers; whenever he lectured it accorded with the emperor's intent, and daily he was consulted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1341 the Kuizhang Pavilion was renamed the Hall of Propagating Culture and the Directorate of Literary Arts the Directorate of Honoring Culture. Boqi was appointed lecturer there, teaching the sons of imperial affines and great ministers; every lecture pleased the emperor, and he was consulted daily.

sentences.zh: 帝以伯琦工書法，命篆「宣文閣寶」，仍題扁宣文閣；

translations.literal: The emperor, because Boqi was skilled in calligraphy, ordered him to seal-cut the "Treasure of the Hall of Propagating Culture" and also to inscribe the hall plaque;
translations.idiomatic: Because Boqi was skilled in calligraphy, the emperor ordered him to cut the seal "Treasure of the Hall of Propagating Culture" and inscribe the hall plaque;

sentences.zh: 及摹王羲之所書蘭亭序、智永所書千文，刻石閣中。

translations.literal: and to copy Wang Xizhi's Lanting Preface and Zhiyong's Thousand-Character Essay and carve them in stone within the hall.
translations.idiomatic: and to copy Wang Xizhi's Lanting Preface and Zhiyong's Thousand-Character Essay and carve them in stone within the hall.

sentences.zh: 自是累轉官，皆宣文、崇文之間，而眷遇益隆矣。

translations.literal: From this his successive transfers were all between the Hall of Propagating Culture and the Directorate of Honoring Culture, and imperial favor grew ever more exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter his successive appointments were all within the Hall of Propagating Culture and the Directorate of Honoring Culture, and imperial favor toward him grew ever greater.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗呼其字伯溫而不名。

translations.literal: The emperor would sometimes call him by his style Bowen and not by his name.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sometimes addressed him by his style Bowen rather than by his personal name.

sentences.zh: 會御史奏風憲宜用近臣，特命僉廣東廉訪司事。

translations.literal: When censors memorialized that surveillance statutes should employ close ministers, he was specially ordered as Associate Surveillance Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: When censors memorialized that surveillance posts should be filled by close ministers of the throne, he was specially appointed associate surveillance commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 八年，召入為翰林待制，預修后妃、功臣列傳，累陞直學士。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was summoned as Hanlin Attendant Drafter, participated in compiling the biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers, and was repeatedly promoted to Academician.
translations.idiomatic: In 1348 he was summoned as Hanlin attendant drafter, participated in compiling the biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers, and was promoted to academician.

sentences.zh: 十二年，有旨令南士皆得居省臺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year an edict ordered that southerners might all hold Secretariat and Censorate posts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1352 an edict declared that southerners might again hold Secretariat and Censorate posts.

sentences.zh: 除伯琦兵部侍郎，遂與貢師泰同擢監察御史。

translations.literal: Boqi was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of War and then, together with Gong Shitai, was jointly promoted to Surveillance Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Boqi was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of War and then, together with Gong Shitai, was promoted to surveillance censor.

sentences.zh: 兩人皆南士之望，一時榮之。

translations.literal: Both men were the hope of southern scholars, and for a time it was counted an honor.
translations.idiomatic: Both men were leading figures among southern scholars, and for a time their appointments were celebrated as a great honor.

sentences.zh: 時御史大夫也先帖木兒以大軍南討，而失律喪師，陝西行臺監察御史劉希曾等十人共劾奏之。

translations.literal: At that time Censor-in-Chief Yesian Timur led a great army south in campaign but violated discipline and lost his army; ten surveillance censors of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat including Liu Xizeng jointly impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Censor-in-Chief Yesian Timur led a great army on a southern campaign but violated discipline and lost his forces; ten surveillance censors of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, including Liu Xizeng, jointly impeached him.

sentences.zh: 伯琦乃劾希曾等越分干譽，希曾等皆坐左遷，補郡判官，由是不為公論所與。

translations.literal: Boqi then impeached Xizeng and the others for overstepping their rank to seek reputation; Xizeng and the others were all punished with demotion and reassigned as assistant prefects, and from this he was not supported by public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Boqi then impeached Xizeng and the others for overstepping their authority to seek reputation; they were all demoted to assistant prefects, and from this Boqi lost public support.

sentences.zh: 十三年，遷崇文太監，兼經筵官，代祀天妃。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Director of the Directorate of Honoring Culture, concurrently a classics-lecture official, and performed sacrifice to the Heavenly Consort by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1353 he was transferred to director of the Directorate of Honoring Culture, concurrently a classics-lecture official, and performed sacrifice to the Heavenly Consort by proxy.

sentences.zh: 丁內艱。

translations.literal: He entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十四年，起復為江東肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was recalled from mourning as Surveillance Commissioner of Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1354 he was recalled from mourning as surveillance commissioner of Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 長槍鎖南班陷寧國，伯琦與僚佐倉皇出見之，尋遁走至杭州除兵部尚書，未行，改浙西肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: Changqiang Suonanban seized Ningguo; Boqi and his staff in panic went out to meet them, then fled to Hangzhou and was appointed Minister of War but did not depart, and was changed to Surveillance Commissioner of western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Changqiang Suonanban seized Ningguo; Boqi and his staff went out in panic to meet the rebels, then fled to Hangzhou, where he was appointed minister of war but did not take up the post, and was reassigned surveillance commissioner of western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 江南行臺監察御史余觀，糾言伯琦失陷寧國，宜正其罪。

translations.literal: Surveillance Censor Yu Guan of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat impeached Boqi for losing Ningguo and held that his crime should be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance Censor Yu Guan of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat impeached Boqi for losing Ningguo and argued that he should be punished.

sentences.zh: 十七年，江浙行省丞相達識帖睦爾承制假伯琦參知政事，招諭平江張士誠。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Chancellor Toghuz Temür of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, by imperial commission, provisionally appointed Boqi Associate Administrator to summon and instruct Zhang Shicheng of Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1357 Chancellor Toghuz Temür of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, by imperial commission, provisionally appointed Boqi associate administrator to negotiate Zhang Shicheng's surrender at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 士誠既降，江南行臺監察御史亦辯釋伯琦罪，除同知太常禮儀院事，士誠留之，未行，拜資政大夫、江浙行省左丞。

translations.literal: After Shicheng submitted, surveillance censors of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat also argued to clear Boqi's crime; he was appointed Associate Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, but Shicheng detained him and he did not depart; he was appointed Grand Master for Governance and Left Chancellor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang Shicheng submitted, Jiangnan surveillance censors also argued to clear Boqi's guilt; he was appointed associate director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, but Zhang Shicheng detained him and he did not depart. He was then appointed Grand Master for Governance and left chancellor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 於是留平江者十餘年。

translations.literal: He thus remained at Pingjiang for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: He remained at Pingjiang for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 士誠既滅，伯琦乃得歸鄱陽，尋卒。

translations.literal: After Shicheng was destroyed, Boqi was able to return to Poyang and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang Shicheng was destroyed, Boqi was able to return to Poyang and died shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 伯琦儀觀溫雅，粹然如玉，雖遭時多艱，而善於自保。

translations.literal: Boqi's bearing was mild and elegant, pure as jade; though he encountered many hardships of the age, he was skilled at preserving himself.
translations.idiomatic: Boqi's bearing was mild and elegant, pure as jade; though he lived through turbulent times, he was skilled at preserving himself.

sentences.zh: 博學工文章，而尤以篆、隸、真、草擅名當時。

translations.literal: Broadly learned and skilled in literary composition, he was especially renowned in his time for seal, clerical, regular, and cursive scripts.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly learned and skilled in literary composition, he was especially renowned in his time for seal, clerical, regular, and cursive calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 嘗著六書正訛、說文字原二書，又有詩文稿若干卷。

translations.literal: He once authored two books, Corrections to the Six Scripts and Origins of the Explanation of Characters, and also had poetry and prose drafts in several juan.
translations.idiomatic: He authored two works, Corrections to the Six Scripts and Origins of the Explanation of Characters, and left poetry and prose drafts in several juan.

sentences.zh: 吳當字伯尚，澄之孫也。

translations.literal: Wu Dang, courtesy name Boshang, was the grandson of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dang, styled Boshang, was the grandson of Wu Cheng.

sentences.zh: 當幼承祖訓，以穎悟篤實稱。

translations.literal: Dang in youth received his grandfather's instruction and was acclaimed for keen intelligence and solid integrity.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Dang received his grandfather's instruction and was acclaimed for keen intelligence and solid integrity.

sentences.zh: 長精通經史百家言，侍其祖至京，補國子生。

translations.literal: When grown he mastered the classics, histories, and the teachings of the hundred schools; he attended his grandfather to the capital and was enrolled as an Imperial Academy student.
translations.idiomatic: As a man he mastered the classics, histories, and the teachings of the hundred schools; he accompanied his grandfather to the capital and was enrolled as an Imperial Academy student.

sentences.zh: 久之，澄既捐館，四方學子從澄遊者，悉就當卒業焉。

translations.literal: After a long time Cheng had passed away; scholars from all directions who had studied with Cheng all came to Dang to complete their training.
translations.idiomatic: After a time Cheng died, and scholars from all directions who had studied with him all came to Dang to complete their training.

sentences.zh: 至正五年，以父文蔭，授萬億四庫照磨，未上，用薦者改國子助教。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhizheng, through his father Wen's yin privilege, he was appointed Reviewing Clerk of the Treasury of Ten Thousand Myriads but did not take up the post; through a recommender he was changed to Assistant Instructor of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1345, through his father Wen's yin privilege, he was appointed reviewing clerk of the Treasury of Ten Thousand Myriads but did not take up the post; on recommendation he was appointed assistant instructor of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 勤講解，嚴肄習，諸生皆樂從之。

translations.literal: He diligently lectured and strictly supervised study; all the students gladly followed him.
translations.idiomatic: He lectured diligently and supervised study strictly; all the students gladly followed him.

sentences.zh: 會詔修遼、金、宋三史，當預編纂。

translations.literal: When an edict was issued to compile the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song, Dang participated in the compilation.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict was issued to compile the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song, Dang participated in the compilation.

sentences.zh: 書成，除翰林修撰。

translations.literal: When the books were completed he was appointed Hanlin Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: When the histories were completed he was appointed Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷國子博士。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Erudite of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1347 he was transferred to erudite of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 明年，陞監丞。

translations.literal: The next year he was promoted to Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to supervisor.

sentences.zh: 十年，陞司業。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In 1350 he was promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷翰林待制。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Hanlin Attendant Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to Hanlin attendant drafter.

sentences.zh: 又明年，改禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: The year after that he was changed to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he was reassigned vice minister of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢監察御史，尋復為國子司業。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to Surveillance Censor and soon restored as Vice Director of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1353 he was promoted to surveillance censor and soon restored as vice director of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷禮部郎中。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 又明年，除翰林直學士。

translations.literal: The year after that he was appointed Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he was appointed Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 時江南兵起且五年，大臣有薦當世居江西，習知江西民俗，且其才可任政事者，詔特授江西肅政廉訪使，偕江西行省參政火你赤、兵部尚書黃昭，招捕江西諸郡，便宜行事。

translations.literal: At that time warfare in the Jiangnan region had arisen for nearly five years; a great minister recommended that Dang had long resided in Jiangxi, was thoroughly familiar with Jiangxi customs, and that his talent could undertake government affairs. An edict specially appointed him Surveillance Commissioner of Jiangxi, together with Associate Administrator Huonichi of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and Minister of War Huang Zhao, to summon and suppress the various prefectures of Jiangxi, with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Warfare in the Jiangnan region had been raging for nearly five years when a great minister recommended Dang, who had long lived in Jiangxi and knew its customs well, as capable of government affairs. An edict specially appointed him surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, together with Associate Administrator Huonichi of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and Minister of War Huang Zhao, to pacify the prefectures of Jiangxi with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 當以朝廷兵力不給，既受命至江南，即召募民兵，由浙入閩。

translations.literal: Dang, considering that the court's military strength was insufficient, once he received his commission and reached the Jiangnan region immediately recruited militia and entered Fujian from Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Judging that the court's military strength was insufficient, once he received his commission and reached the Jiangnan region Dang immediately recruited militia and entered Fujian from Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 至江西境建昌界，招安新城孫塔，擒殄李三。

translations.literal: Reaching the Jianchang border in Jiangxi territory, he won over Sun Ta of Xincheng and captured and exterminated Li San.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the Jianchang border in Jiangxi, he won over Sun Ta of Xincheng and captured and killed Li San.

sentences.zh: 道路既通，乃進攻南豐，渠凶鄭天瑞遁，鄭原自刎死。

translations.literal: Once the roads were open he advanced to attack Nanfeng; the ringleader Zheng Tianrui fled, and Zheng Yuan killed himself by cutting his throat.
translations.idiomatic: Once the roads were secure he advanced on Nanfeng; the ringleader Zheng Tianrui fled, and Zheng Yuan committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調檢校章迪率本部兵，與黃昭夾攻撫州，勦殺首寇胡志學，進兵復崇仁、宜黃。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he transferred Reviewing Officer Zhang Di to lead his own troops and, together with Huang Zhao, attacked Fuzhou from both sides, exterminated the chief bandit Hu Zhixue, and advanced to recover Chongren and Yihuang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1356 he ordered Reviewing Officer Zhang Di to lead his troops and, together with Huang Zhao, attacked Fuzhou from both sides, killed the chief bandit Hu Zhixue, and advanced to recover Chongren and Yihuang.

sentences.zh: 於是建、撫兩郡悉定。

translations.literal: Thereupon the two circuits of Jian and Fu were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Jian and Fu regions were entirely pacified.

sentences.zh: 是時，參知政事朶歹緫兵撫、建，積年無功。

translations.literal: At that time Associate Administrator Duodai commanded troops in Fu and Jian for many years without achievement.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Associate Administrator Duodai had commanded troops in Fu and Jian for years without success.

sentences.zh: 因忌當屢捷，功在己上，又以為南人不宜緫兵，則搆為飛語，謂當與黃昭皆與寇通。

translations.literal: Because he resented Dang's repeated victories and that his merit stood above his own, and also held that southerners were unsuited to command troops, he fabricated slanderous rumors, saying that Dang and Huang Zhao were both in communication with the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Resenting Dang's repeated victories and his own lesser merit, and believing that southerners should not command troops, he fabricated slanderous rumors claiming that Dang and Huang Zhao were both colluding with the rebels.

sentences.zh: 有旨解二人兵柄，除當撫州路緫管，昭臨江路緫管，並供億平章火你赤軍。

translations.literal: An edict stripped the two men of military authority, appointed Dang General Manager of Fuzhou Circuit and Zhao General Manager of Linjiang Circuit, and ordered them both to supply provisions for Grand Councillor Huonichi's army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped them of military command, appointed Dang general manager of Fuzhou Circuit and Zhao general manager of Linjiang Circuit, and ordered them both to supply Grand Councillor Huonichi's army.

sentences.zh: 火你赤殺當從事官范淳及章迪，將士皆憤怒不平，當諭之曰：「上命不可違也。

translations.literal: Huonichi killed Dang's staff officers Fan Chun and Zhang Di; officers and soldiers were all angry and resentful. Dang instructed them, saying: "The imperial command cannot be disobeyed."
translations.idiomatic: Huonichi killed Dang's staff officers Fan Chun and Zhang Di; the officers and soldiers were furious. Dang told them: "The imperial command cannot be disobeyed."

sentences.zh: 」而火你赤又上章言：「二人者，難任牧民。

translations.literal: Huonichi also submitted a memorial saying: "These two men are unfit to govern the people."
translations.idiomatic: Huonichi also memorialized: "These two men are unfit to govern the people."

sentences.zh: 」尋有旨當與昭皆罷緫管，除名。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered that Dang and Zhao both be dismissed as general managers and their names removed from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict dismissed Dang and Zhao from their posts as general managers and struck their names from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 十八年，火你赤自瑞州還龍興，當、昭皆隨軍不敢去。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Huonichi returned from Ruizhou to Longxing; Dang and Zhao both followed the army and dared not leave.
translations.idiomatic: In 1358 Huonichi returned from Ruizhou to Longxing; Dang and Zhao both followed the army and dared not leave.

sentences.zh: 先是，當與昭平賊功狀，自廣東由海道未達京師，而朶歹、火你赤等公牘乃先至，故朝廷責當、昭，皆左遷。

translations.literal: Earlier, Dang's and Zhao's reports on pacifying the bandits, sent from Guangdong by sea route, had not reached the capital, while the official documents of Duodai, Huonichi, and others arrived first; therefore the court blamed Dang and Zhao, and both were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Dang's and Zhao's reports on pacifying the rebels, sent from Guangdong by sea, had not reached the capital, while the documents of Duodai, Huonichi, and others arrived first; the court therefore blamed Dang and Zhao and demoted them both.

sentences.zh: 及得當、昭功狀，乃始知其誣，詔拜當中奉大夫、江西行省參知政事，昭湖廣行省參知政事。

translations.literal: When Dang's and Zhao's merit reports were received, the court then learned of the false accusations and issued an edict appointing Dang Grand Master of the Palace Attendant and Associate Administrator of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, and Zhao Associate Administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Dang's and Zhao's merit reports arrived, the court learned of the false accusations and issued an edict appointing Dang Grand Master of the Palace Attendant and associate administrator of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, and Zhao associate administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 命未下，而陳友諒已陷江西諸郡。

translations.literal: Before the orders were issued, Chen Youliang had already seized the various prefectures of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Before the orders were issued, Chen Youliang had already seized the prefectures of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 火你赤棄城遁，當乃戴黃冠，著道士服，杜門不出，日以著書為事。

translations.literal: Huonichi abandoned the city and fled; Dang then put on a yellow cap and Daoist robes, shut his door and did not go out, and daily made authorship his occupation.
translations.idiomatic: Huonichi abandoned the city and fled; Dang then put on a yellow cap and Daoist robes, shut his door, and devoted himself daily to writing.

sentences.zh: 友諒遣人辟之，當卧床不食，以死自誓，乃舁床載之舟，送江州，拘留一年，終不為屈。

translations.literal: Youliang sent men to recruit him; Dang lay in bed and refused to eat, vowing death; they thereupon carried his bed onto a boat and sent him to Jiangzhou, detained him for a year, and in the end he would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Youliang sent men to recruit him; Dang lay in bed and refused to eat, vowing to die rather than submit. They carried his bed onto a boat and sent him to Jiangzhou, where he was detained for a year, but in the end he would not yield.

sentences.zh: 遂隱居廬陵吉水之谷坪。

translations.literal: He then went into seclusion at Guping in Jishui, Luling.
translations.idiomatic: He then went into seclusion at Guping in Jishui, Luling.

sentences.zh: 逾年，以疾卒，年六十五。

translations.literal: After more than a year he died of illness at age sixty-five.
translations.idiomatic: A little more than a year later he died of illness at the age of sixty-five.

sentences.zh: 所著書，有周禮纂言及學言稿。

translations.literal: Among his authored books were Collected Explanations of the Rites of Zhou and Drafts of Learning.
translations.idiomatic: His works included Collected Explanations of the Rites of Zhou and Drafts of Learning.
